context: Request: deals in the firm's files where a fraud carve-out to the indemnity cap was negotiated (M&A indemnity playbook), with how it was papered. Rubric: 27 qualifying M&A matters (1001-00003/04/05/07, 1003-00003/04, 1004-00003, 1005-00006, 1006-00006/07/08, 1007-00006, 1008-00008, 1009-00003, 1011-00006, 1013-00006, 1015-00004, 1017-00006, 1018-00008, 1032-00005, 1037-00006, 1038-00008/09, 1039-00004, 1041-00003, 1042-00004, 1046-00001), each identified correctly, plus precision (1022-00002 is outside the set).

runs.failure_point: After several scans of 120K-170K characters each, a final uncapped section-printing script over 14 matters returned about 4.1M characters and filled the context before any answer was written.

first_error.critic_note: The run ended before stage_end; the previous review had flagged the unread 170K-character extraction output.
first_error.why: The script printed every phrase-hit section for 14 matters with no output cap, on top of several earlier outputs of 120K-170K characters, so the context filled and the run ended with no response written.

runs.failure_point: It listed and read only a hand-picked subset of the matters its scans had surfaced, and in the answer it described documents under the wrong matter numbers and counted an extra matter.

first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The listing review said about 60 surfaced matters were never listed; the agent listed 16 more in attempt 2 but most needed matters stayed unopened.
first_error.why: Most needed matters appeared in the agent's path searches and scan output, but when choosing what to list and read it took 14 (later 30) hand-picked matters and never opened many of the others.

other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review warned of identifier confusion between internal and folder numbers; the check only confirmed that paths exist.
other_errors.why: The answer pairs documents read in parallel batches at [73]-[98] with the wrong matter numbers (one matter described as another client's deal, siblings swapped), so several needed matters are misdescribed.
The answer excludes a matter it listed at [59]-[60] as a preferred-stock financing although its documents carry a negotiated fraud carve-out.

other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review flagged draft-only and sibling entries inflating the count.
other_errors.why: The answer asserts a further matter as an executed precedent with a fraud carve-out.

runs.failure_point: It worked from a hand-picked list of 17 scan candidates and read only about a dozen, leaving most needed matters unopened; it also misnamed one matter's client and counted an extra matter.

first_error.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [52] named the hand-picked 17-matter list; the agent ran a wider confirmation scan but still opened only about a dozen matters.
first_error.why: Most needed matters appeared in the agent's path searches and scans, but it chose 17 matters for its snippet script and later reads and never opened many of the others.

other_errors.critic_note: Reviews in reach asked to check rows and keep the matter set unchanged.
other_errors.why: Matters whose agreements or escrow papers it read or grepped at [61]-[74] are left out of the answer without a stated reason.

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) Reviews at [76] and [101] named the internal memo matter numbers that differ from folder numbers; the agent's reconciliation kept the memo's client name for one matter.
other_errors.why: The answer describes one needed matter under another client's name taken from an internal memo header read at [91]-[93].

other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review flagged matters supported only by snippets or memos inflating the count.
other_errors.why: The answer asserts a further matter as a fraud carve-out precedent.

divergence: All three runs failed. T0 overflowed the context with an uncapped section-printing script after several large scans, before any answer or review. T1 and T2 failed the same way: both surfaced nearly all needed matters through path searches and scans, then hand-picked a few dozen candidates and read only about a dozen, so most needed matters were never opened (the reviews named the hand-picked lists; the agents widened slightly). Both also misattributed documents in the answer (parallel read results returning in a different order, or an internal memo number and client name) and counted one extra matter.
